# The LSP 3.18 meta model

`metaModel-3.18.json` is the Language Server Protocol 3.18 specification's
meta model, unchanged, from
https://github.com/microsoft/language-server-protocol, file
`_specifications/lsp/3.18/metaModel/metaModel.json` on the `gh-pages`
branch (version 3.18.0, fetched 2026-10-24).

tests/common/spec.rs checks every message the server sends in the tests
against it.
